referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Kome Care website in London, England uses pale care setting with an independent nurse-led message in navy. Navigation is phone and email utility above service navigation. Its page moves through care opening, service index, clinical trust explanation, family and professional referral split, funding guidance, testimonials, advice articles, contact, with labeled care options in calm modular tiles. supportive home and caregiver images, never anonymous stock staff claims. Transferable mechanics are dual-audience referral fork, funding guidance, navy clinical trust band. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
